file_descriptions.release_manifest.json: V3 packaging manifest with row counts, source counts, canonical Parquet checksum, lineage, and the documented removal of the duplicate V2 CSV.
file_descriptions.missing_source_months.csv: Eight official source-month attachments that were unavailable and not fabricated.
file_descriptions.missingness_summary.csv: Source-level summary of missing five-minute timestamps across the release period.
file_descriptions.south_korea_power_grid_5min.parquet: Recommended analytics file: the complete normalized 2015-2026 KPX 5-minute dataset in one ZSTD Parquet file with 1,008,249,180 rows.

note: Core release verification is independent of optional Data Explorer file-description synchronization. The latter is tracked explicitly because Kaggle's dataset metadata API may not persist those fields for an existing processed version.
